parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe representing Earth, made of plastic with printed map details.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface showing continents, oceans, and countries. It can rotate around its axis for educational use.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates freely around a tilted axis supported by the circular frame.

parts.name: Circle (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is the circular ring structure that holds the globe sphere in place, likely made of metal.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and allows the sphere to rotate smoothly within the frame.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the sphere rotates within it.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the stand and supporting base of the globe, typically made of wood for stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the entire globe structure, keeping it upright and balanced on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during normal use.
